what: Put a WhatsApp button next to every phone number HQ shows: each lead, and the owner on a gym page
why: Indian gym owners answer WhatsApp before calls; today a lead and an owner show only a call link, so a follow-up text means copying the number into WhatsApp by hand
impact_why: Used on every lead follow-up and every owner contact, the main daily sales task
my_view: My view: do it; one extra link per number that opens WhatsApp to that mobile, no message written for him.

what: After Make a gym or a new sign-in code, add "Open in WhatsApp" that opens a chat with that owner with the message already filled in
why: The card already has the owner mobile and the ready message, yet he must press Copy, open WhatsApp, find the owner and paste: four steps where one would do
impact_why: Every new gym and every lost sign-in goes through this card; the code only lives 30 minutes
my_view: My view: do it, but he still presses Send in WhatsApp himself; keep Copy for when the owner uses another number.

what: Give Leads a Show filter (New first; Won and Lost hidden by default) and make the Needs you lead line open only the new ones
why: Needs you says "N new leads to call" but opens the full list of every lead for 12 months, won and lost mixed in, so he scrolls to find the new ones
impact_why: Grows worse with every lead; small today
my_view: My view: do it; the same Show box the Feedback page already has.

what: Let a lead carry a "call back on" date, and list leads due today on Needs you
why: A lead marked Called or Demo drops off Needs you for good; nothing reminds him to call back. Sales tools such as HubSpot CRM and Zoho CRM (follow-up tasks with due dates, as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live) are built around this
impact_why: A demo with no follow-up is the most common lost sale for a one-person sales desk
my_view: My view: worth building next after the quick wins; one date box per lead and one Needs you line. Needs a small database change, so his yes first.

what: Add two call lines to Needs you: free trials ending in 3 days, and trial gyms with no desk activity for 3 days
why: The gym list already counts trials ending soon, but only on its tiles; Needs you, the page he opens first, never asks him to call a gym before its trial runs out or while it is going quiet
impact_why: Trial to paid is where the money is decided; a call in the last days is the cheapest lever he has
my_view: My view: do it; the numbers are already read for the gym list, so this is mostly a new line and a filter.

what: On a gym page, show what this gym sent (feedback and help questions) and where it came from (its lead); make the gym code on a feedback card a link to that gym
why: Before calling an owner he must open Feedback and Leads separately and match the gym by code by eye
impact_why: Saves a search before every owner call and stops a call that misses an open complaint
my_view: My view: do it in two steps; the link from feedback to the gym first (small), the lists on the gym page later.

what: Add a private note box on each gym page ("owner wants Hindi bills, call after 6 pm")
why: Leads have a note but a gym does not; once a lead becomes a gym, what he learnt on calls has nowhere to live
impact_why: Helps every repeat call as the number of gyms grows
my_view: My view: do it later; carry the lead note over when the gym is made from a lead. Facts about the gym only, never member details, and it goes in the HQ log like other HQ actions.

what: Reorder the gym page: facts and owner first, then day-to-day tools (plan, status), then a folded "More tools" for rare or risky ones (sign out everywhere, new sign-in code, AI limits, support access)
why: The gym page stacks about a dozen cards in one long column, with Sign out everywhere above AI credits, so a phone user scrolls past risky buttons to reach common ones
impact_why: Every gym visit; also lowers the chance of a wrong tap on a risky action on a phone
my_view: My view: do it with the next HQ change, not alone; pure layout, nothing new to test except the fold.

what: Saved replies: a short list of ready answers he can drop into a feedback reply and edit
why: Each reply is typed from blank, and many questions repeat (how to check in, how to pay). Help-desk tools such as Intercom (Macros), Freshdesk (Canned responses) and Zoho Desk (Templates) all have this, as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live
impact_why: Grows with members; cuts reply time and keeps answers the same each time
my_view: My view: wait until he answers more than about 5 questions a week; until then the English helper is enough.

what: Show how members' shared links turn into gyms: leads from members, how many became Won, and a Show filter for them
why: Leads shows only "From members' shared links: N of M", so he cannot see whether the recommend-to-your-gym loop makes any paying gym
impact_why: Few leads today; matters once the member app is widely used
my_view: My view: do it with the Leads filter (the Show filter idea), same change; one more count on one line.

what: Add an "Enquiries to call today" idea to Today for you, with See who, ranked near the top when any are due or overdue
why: The ideas cover birthdays, festivals, renewals, dues, absent members and win-backs, but never the people who asked about joining. The assistant already knows who is due a call back; it only shows that if the owner thinks to ask
impact_why: A called-back enquiry is the cheapest new member; every gym gets walk-ins and calls daily
my_view: My view: do it first; the list already exists, it only needs a row in the ideas. No AI cost, so it can be free like See who.

what: Give each person in "Enquiries to call today" and "Enquiries still open" a Call and a WhatsApp button
why: The enquiry rows are plain text: name and interest only. To act, the owner must leave the assistant, open Enquiries, find the person and tap there
impact_why: Removes three taps from the gym's main sales task
my_view: My view: do it; the owner still presses Send in WhatsApp himself, nothing goes out on its own.

what: Make the box on Today's AI card a real typing box with a microphone, so a question can be asked without first opening the assistant
why: Today's box is a button dressed as a text box: tapping it opens the assistant, where the owner types in a second box. Speaking is only offered inside the assistant
impact_why: The Today screen is the first thing an owner sees; one tap fewer on every question
my_view: My view: worth it but small; keep the answer opening in the panel or full screen as now, only the typing moves earlier.

what: In History, let a "Not sent" draft open again as its card (message, renewal, payment) instead of only putting the sentence back in the box
why: A tap on any past task only refills the ask box, so finishing yesterday's draft means asking again, using one of today's limited questions and getting a fresh AI draft that loses the owner's edits
impact_why: Owners often draft at night and send in the morning
my_view: My view: good, but only after the saved task keeps the owner's final words (today History keeps what the AI first wrote); do that fix first.

what: Make the assistant know the page it was opened from: on a member's page, show chips like "Renew Ravi", "Ravi paid", "Is Ravi's plan still on?"
why: The small context sent with each question holds the gym, plans, batches and trainers, never the screen the owner is on, so on a member's page he must still type the member's name, which then goes through name matching and sometimes a Which one? card
impact_why: Removes typing and the wrong-member risk on the most common tasks; Mindbody Messenger[ai] and Glofox assistants act on the open record (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live)
my_view: My view: do it as chips only (no AI call until tapped); the member is picked by the page, not by the AI reading a name.

what: Add a "Bring a friend" idea for regulars (members who came most this month), with a ready WhatsApp message carrying the gym's friend-enquiry link
why: There is no growth loop in Today for you: every idea talks to members about their own plan. Happy regulars are the best source of new members, and the gym page already takes friend enquiries
impact_why: A steady referral habit is how small Indian gyms grow; PushPress Grow and Gymdesk push referral asks to engaged members (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live)
my_view: My view: try it once a month at most, not daily, and only for members with recent visits; let the owner see the list before anything is sent.

what: Add "Send them a fee reminder" under the "Members who owe fees" list, as the separate "Fees due" answer already has
why: The same people come back from two questions with different next steps: one offers a fee reminder, the list version offers nothing
impact_why: Small, but makes the two dues answers behave the same
my_view: My view: do it with the next assistant change; one line.

what: After a save, offer the natural next step on the done card: after adding a member, "Invite to the app" and "Send a welcome"; after saving an enquiry, "Send a WhatsApp hello"
why: The done card shows only Open page (and WhatsApp for a message). A new member who never gets the app also misses in-app messages, and the invite step already exists elsewhere in the assistant
impact_why: Every new member and enquiry; app installs feed reminders and retention
my_view: My view: do it; the buttons only open the existing invite or WhatsApp screens, no new credits.

what: Let desk staff use the assistant for questions only (who owes, is this plan valid, who came today), with saves and messages left to the owner
why: Today the whole assistant is hidden from anyone but the owner, yet the desk answers these questions all day by searching lists
impact_why: The desk is the busiest user of the panel; questions are cheap
my_view: My view: wait; first measure how owners use it (nobody can tell today), then decide. Money totals must stay hidden from staff as they are now.

what: When Today's AI card has no ideas, say so in one calm line ("Nothing needs you today") instead of showing only the box
why: With no ideas the card shows a heading and a box, which reads as broken or empty rather than good news
impact_why: Polish on quiet days
my_view: My view: small; do it only alongside another change to this card.

what: After "Add a person", open that person's sign-in code straight away, with Send on WhatsApp ready
why: Today the owner adds the person, the sheet closes with a toast, and he must then find the new row and tap Make sign-in code: a second trip for the one thing every new person needs
impact_why: Every new staff member and trainer goes through this; it is the first thing a new gym does after Create my gym
my_view: My view: do it; reuse the code sheet that already exists, and keep a "Not now" for an owner adding someone who is not at the desk.

what: Add a Manager kind of person: front desk rights plus money totals and receipt cancels, set by the owner
why: Rights are only Owner or Staff today; a typed job like Manager is a label and changes nothing, so an owner who has a manager must either make him a full owner or keep doing cancels and day totals himself. Glofox and Mindbody let the owner choose staff permissions per role (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live)
impact_why: Bigger gyms with a manager hit this daily; single-owner gyms never do
my_view: My view: discuss before building; it touches money rights, so start with one fixed Manager set (totals plus cancel receipt), not a tick-box screen, and the server must enforce it, not only the panel.

what: In the "Sign out of this device?" sheet, when work is still waiting, add a "Send now" button and list what is waiting
why: The sheet only says to wait for All sent and greys out Sign out; at closing time the staff member has no button to push the sends and no idea which payments are stuck
impact_why: Happens at shift end on desks with weak internet, exactly when cash is waiting
my_view: My view: do it; the panel already has a send-everything routine, so this is a button and a short list.

what: Remember the last mobile number used on this device, so a returning person types only the PIN
why: The sign-in form always starts empty unless another screen passes a number in; on a shared desk computer each shift change means typing the 10-digit number again
impact_why: Sign-ins are rare because sign-ins do not run out, so the saving is small per gym
my_view: My view: do it only with a "Not you?" link to clear it, and keep only the number, never the PIN.

what: Cut "PIN again" from Create my gym and use a show-PIN eye instead
why: Create my gym already asks for gym name, your name, mobile, PIN, PIN again, a terms tick and a WhatsApp step: seven things before the owner sees his gym, and the repeat box is one of the easiest to drop
impact_why: One less box at the moment a new gym owner decides whether to carry on
my_view: My view: worth a small test, not a sure win; the repeat box guards against a typo locking the owner out on day one, so only drop it together with a show-PIN eye.

what: On the sign-in code sheet, let "Copy" copy the whole ready message (code, number and link), not just the 6 digits
why: Copy takes only the code, so an owner who sends it by SMS or another app has to type the link and the mobile himself; the full message already exists for the WhatsApp button
impact_why: Only for owners who do not use WhatsApp for staff, which is a minority in India
my_view: My view: do it as a second button "Copy message"; keep "Copy the code" for reading it out.

what: When the owner is the only person on Staff & sign-in, show one line asking him to add his front desk, saying why it helps
why: A gym with only the owner listed sees just his own row and an Add button at the top; nothing says that adding staff gives each receipt the name of who took the cash and lets him stop sharing his PIN
impact_why: Shared owner logins hide who took cash; the nudge pushes gyms toward named staff, which also keeps them using the panel
my_view: My view: do it; one line and a button in the empty state, no pop-up.

what: Fingerprint or face sign-in on the device instead of typing the PIN
why: Some banking and gym apps let a returning person sign in with the phone's fingerprint (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live); here every new sign-in is mobile plus a 6-digit PIN or code
impact_why: Sign-ins do not run out today, so people rarely type the PIN; the gain is small
my_view: My view: do not build now; it is a large change across browsers for little daily gain. Revisit only if sign-ins start to run out after a time limit.

what: After a logo upload or a colour change, keep a "Not saved yet" bar with Save pinned to the bottom of the screen, and ask before leaving the page with unsaved changes
why: The logo uploads at once but members get it only after Save, which sits at the very bottom under four cards; leaving the page throws the new logo and colour away with no question
impact_why: Every owner who sets a look meets this once; a lost logo makes them think the upload failed
my_view: My view: do it; a pinned bar and a leave-page question are small, and they stop the most likely way the first set-up goes wrong.

what: After Save, show "Your new look is also on" with one-tap links: print the new join poster, the member card, the gym web page and the growth report
why: The logo already flows into the poster, member card, web page and growth report, but Branding never says so, so owners do not reprint the poster that brings new members in
impact_why: Turns a one-off settings visit into a fresh poster on the gym wall, the main way members find the app
my_view: My view: do it; the links point at screens that already exist, and the poster is the growth step that matters.

what: Give the join poster a band in the gym's own colour (top or bottom strip), like the member card already has
why: The poster is always white with black words; only the logo is the gym's, so it looks like MettleUp's poster rather than the gym's
impact_why: A poster that looks like the gym gets put up; one in someone else's style often does not
my_view: My view: do it, but a thin strip only, so printing stays cheap on a desk inkjet.

what: Show the opening screen too: a small second preview of the logo-on-launch screen next to the Workout tab and home-screen icon
why: The words say members see the logo big when the app opens, but the preview never shows that screen, so owners cannot judge how their logo looks large
impact_why: Helps owners pick between the cleaned and original logo; nice, not urgent
my_view: My view: worth doing with the next Branding change; not on its own.

what: Let an owner try their logo and colour in the phone preview before the member app is turned on, then show "Turn on the member app so members see this"
why: Today a gym without the member app sees only a "Turn on the member app first" card, so the most visual reason to turn the app on is hidden until after they do it
impact_why: Seeing their own gym in a phone is a strong push to switch the member app on, which every later growth step depends on
my_view: My view: do it; it reuses the same preview and needs only a "not saved, app is off" state. Branded-app sellers such as ABC Glofox, PushPress and Mindbody lead their sales with a mock-up of the gym's own app (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live).

what: Add six starter colour dots (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple tuned for the dark screens) above the colour code box
why: An owner with no logo, or a logo with no colour, must use a colour wheel or type a code like #E11D48, which many gym owners have never done
impact_why: Only for owners without a usable logo colour; the logo suggestion already covers most
my_view: My view: do it only if the set-up step numbers show owners stopping at Colour; otherwise skip.

what: Offer an "Ask MettleUp to set it up" button on Branding that sends the logo to the team, instead of the long ChatGPT steps for a logo with a photo behind it
why: The help for a busy logo asks the owner to use ChatGPT or Gemini, write a prompt and re-upload; many owners will stop here and keep a logo that looks poor on dark screens
impact_why: Only for logos with a photo or pattern behind them; the plain-box case is already automatic
my_view: My view: not now; first count how many logos are kept with a busy background. If many, a done-for-you set-up is a good paid-plan perk.

what: Add a one-tap "Paid in full" button next to Received now on the sell sheet
why: Received now starts at 0, so a member who pays the whole amount (the usual case) needs the desk to type the total by hand; a forgotten box saves the full price as dues
impact_why: Every sale at the counter; a missed box creates false dues that the reminders then chase
my_view: My view: do it; one button that copies Total to pay into the box. Better than changing the default, because part payment stays one tap away too.

what: Show discount chips (5% off, 10% off) under Plan price on the sell sheet, with the rupees off shown
why: Today the desk must work out a discount and type the new price; the desk limit is 10% but nothing helps them stay inside it
impact_why: Discounts are asked for at most Indian gym counters; fewer refused saves and maths mistakes
my_view: My view: do it; for the desk show only the chips its limit allows, the owner keeps the free box.

what: When money is left as dues at a sale, ask "Will pay the rest by" (a date) and show it in Dues and in the reminder
why: "Still due after this" has no promise date, so the owner cannot tell a member who said "next Friday" from one who is dodging
impact_why: Part payment is common in Indian gyms; a promised date makes the dues list a call list and lets reminders go on the right day
my_view: My view: worth building; optional date, default 7 days, used by the Dues list sort and the automatic reminder. Ask before touching reminder timing.

what: Let Collect payment settle all of a member's dues in one receipt, oldest plan first
why: A member owing on two plans needs two separate saves today, one per plan picked from a list
impact_why: Cuts taps for members with a renewal on top of old dues; no more "which plan" question at the counter
my_view: My view: do it later, after the promise date; add an "All dues" choice at the top of the plan list and split the money oldest first on save.

what: After a sale or payment, keep a short success step with "Send receipt on WhatsApp" and "Print"
why: Today the sheet closes with only a toast naming the receipt number, so sending the receipt needs the desk to find it again on the member page
impact_why: Members expect a receipt at once; one tap at the moment of payment instead of three later
my_view: My view: do it; reuse the receipt WhatsApp and print the member page already has, and never offer WhatsApp for a receipt number not yet sure (offline).

what: Give Add member an "Add and sell a plan" button, so a walk-in is added and sold in one go
why: From Members, Add member saves and drops the desk on the member page, where they must find Sell membership; the enquiry flow already chains into the sale
impact_why: Every new walk-in member; one less screen at the busiest moment
my_view: My view: do it; reuse the enquiry flow's chain, keep plain "Add member" for pass members.

what: Add "Referred by" (pick a current member) and "How they heard" to Add member
why: Who brought a walk-in is only free text in Notes ("who referred them"), so the thank-the-referrer flow and source counts never see desk walk-ins; enquiries already carry a source and referral
impact_why: Turns every desk walk-in into a measurable referral loop; Glofox and Mindbody (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live) track lead source on the member
my_view: My view: worth building; optional, one search box over members, feeding the existing thank-you and source report. No reward rules until he decides them.

what: Let a freeze be picked as "away from" and "back on" dates instead of a day count
why: Members say "I am away 5 to 20 December"; the desk has to count the days, and the freeze has no start, so the member looks absent while away
impact_why: Fewer counting mistakes; dated freezes also let away-members be left out of "stopped coming"; Glofox and Gymdesk (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live) schedule freezes by dates
my_view: My view: worth building after the "stopped coming" freeze fault is fixed; keep the day chips for gifts.

what: Let the owner set a freeze allowance per plan (for example 15 days a year) and show days used on the freeze sheet
why: Any freeze of 1 to 365 days is accepted with no record of how much the member already froze, so the desk cannot say no politely
impact_why: Freeze abuse quietly gives away months; most gym software has a freeze policy (Mindbody, Glofox, as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live)
my_view: My view: build only if owners ask; show "used 10 of 15 days" first (cheap), a hard block later.

what: On Cancel receipt, offer reason chips (Wrong amount, Wrong member, Typed twice) and a "Cancel and take again" step
why: The reason is free text with a minimum length, and the usual case (a typo) needs a second trip to Collect payment
impact_why: Owner-only and rare, but cleaner reasons make the cancelled list readable later
my_view: My view: chips yes; "take again" only if he sees owners redoing receipts often.

what: On Today's "Came in today with an ended plan or fees due" card, add a "Renew" or "Take payment" button beside each name, next to Message
why: The member is standing at the desk, yet the only button opens a WhatsApp message; taking the money needs a tap into the member page, then another into renew or payment
impact_why: Money is collected at the moment the member is in front of the desk, every rush hour
my_view: My view: do it; the row already knows the amount due and whether the plan ended, so one button can open the right form. Keep Message for members who left already.

what: An enquiry saved with no follow-up date should come back into "Due" after 3 days instead of waiting in "Later" for ever
why: The add form starts with tomorrow, but if the desk clears the date the person is never on the morning call list again and is quietly lost
impact_why: Every lost walk-in is a lost first month fee
my_view: My view: do it; a small rule change in one place, no new screen. Show "no date set, asked 3 days ago" so the desk knows why it is back.

what: Give enquiries a few follow-up messages for each stage (first call back, free trial invite, an offer, a last try) and count the tries, suggesting "Lost" after the third
why: Today there is one follow-up message for every stage, so the second and third chase repeat the first; GymBook and Wellyx (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live) offer stage templates and attempt counts
impact_why: Most joins come on the second or third follow-up; a different message each time reads less like spam
my_view: My view: worth doing after the desk is using enquiries daily; start with three fixed templates, no editor, and reuse the lost reasons that already exist.

what: Let the automatic "Plan ends soon / today / ended" reminders carry a way to pay: a UPI pay link with the exact amount, or the gym's online renew where it is switched on
why: The app reminders all say "Renew at the desk", while the panel's own WhatsApp renewal message already carries a UPI link with the amount
impact_why: Renewal is the gym's main money; one tap to pay beats a trip to the desk
my_view: My view: do it, after the open finding that many app members get no reminder at all is fixed; otherwise the better words reach nobody.

what: Add an automatic "Fees due" reminder case (off by default, some days after the plan started), so part-paid members get a polite nudge without the owner messaging each one
why: The automatic reminders cover plan ending, birthdays and offers, but not money still owed; the dues list exists and is sorted oldest first, yet chasing it is all by hand
impact_why: Old dues are the money owners most often never collect
my_view: My view: worth it, but off by default and never for terms that have not started (the panel already treats those as not owed). Needs his yes on the words members see.

what: Make the automatic "We haven't seen you" reminder use each member's own rhythm (the same rule the Away list uses), then offer it switched on
why: The reminder is off by default and waits a flat 14 days, while the Away list already judges each member by how often they usually train
impact_why: Catching a member at the first slip is the cheapest save in a gym
my_view: My view: good idea; one rule for "stopped coming" everywhere also narrows the gap the owner sees between lists. Kind words only, as today.

what: When a member's plan ends without a renewal, or the member is archived, ask "why did they leave?" with the same short list enquiries use (price, too far, timings, joined another gym, other)
why: Your growth counts members lost each month but never why; enquiries already capture a lost reason, members do not
impact_why: Knowing that most leavers cite timings or price tells the owner what to change
my_view: My view: do it as an optional one-tap chip on the member page, never a forced question; show the top reason on Your growth.

what: On Expenses, add "Copy last month's fixed costs" so rent, salary and electricity can be entered for a new month in one tap
why: Rent and salaries repeat every month, but each month starts empty and the owner types the same lines again
impact_why: Profit is only right when expenses are typed; fewer taps means more owners keep it up
my_view: My view: do it; copy, then let the owner change any amount before saving. No automatic repeating entries.

what: When a member import finishes, offer "Send these members the app link" right on the done card
why: The done card offers Members, the skipped-rows file and Start over; the app link is a separate Get started step in Settings, so the moment the owner has a full member list is not used to bring them into the app
impact_why: Members in the app are what make reminders, offers and check-ins work for the gym
my_view: My view: do it; a link to the existing invite screen, filtered to the members just imported. No bulk sending.

what: Ask for a friend referral at the happy moments: the "One year with you" wish, a challenge win and a renewal receipt, naming the gym's free days for a friend
why: The gym's refer-a-friend free days exist, but nothing reminds members at the moments they are most likely to say yes; the anniversary wish is off by default
impact_why: Referred members join at a higher rate than any ad, and cost only the free days
my_view: My view: worth trying on the anniversary wish first (one line added when the gym gives free days); measure joins from referrals before adding more places.

what: Put the member app link in the welcome message and the member card message
why: A new member is the best moment to get them onto the app (which keeps them training and brings friends), yet the welcome and card WhatsApp words carry no app link; the desk must send the invite poster separately
impact_why: Every new member goes through one of these two messages; app members are the ones the gym can reach and who share Bring a friend
my_view: My view: do it; one line with the gym's own join link the invite poster already uses. Words go through member-words first.

what: After a free-trial visitor's last day, show "Trial ended, follow up" on Today with a ready WhatsApp message asking them to join
why: The join-online free trial knows when a trial ends, but there is no ready message for that moment and no line telling the desk; a trial that ends quietly is a lost sale
impact_why: A trial person is the warmest lead the gym has; the day after the trial is when most gyms close the sale
my_view: My view: do it once the free trial itself is switched on; one message kind and one Today line, no sending by itself.

what: Add "friend thank-yous to give" to Needs you
why: When a friend a member brought joins, the free days for the member wait for one tap by the owner, but nothing on Needs you counts them, so the thank-you is easy to forget and the member who shared the link feels ignored
impact_why: Bring a friend only grows if members see the reward arrive; a forgotten one kills the next share
my_view: My view: do it; the ready state is already worked out, it only needs a line on Needs you.

what: When the member who brought a friend has no running plan, keep the free days owed and add them on their next renewal
why: Today that case is a dead end (no plan to add the days to); the member who brought a friend gets nothing, and the reward could be the reason they come back
impact_why: Members between plans are exactly the ones a reward can win back
my_view: My view: worth it after the quick wins; needs a small owed-days mark on the member and his yes, since it gives days away later.

what: Let the owner give the new friend a joining reward too (two-sided Bring a friend), as an optional Settings number
why: Only the member who shared gets free days; the friend gets nothing for joining. Two-sided rewards are the usual referral design (Dropbox, Uber; gym software such as Glofox and Wellyx offer referral rewards, as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live)
impact_why: A reason for the friend to join now rather than later
my_view: My view: test it later, not now; first prove members share at all. Off by default; his yes needed because it costs the gym days.

what: Offer a ready WhatsApp message to a pass member (FITPASS, cultpass) who visits often: join us directly and save
why: The panel counts every pass visit but never suggests turning a regular pass visitor into the gym's own member, who pays the gym in full instead of the pass company's per-visit amount
impact_why: Gyms near offices get many pass visitors; each one converted is a full fee instead of a small per-visit payout
my_view: My view: do it as a gentle message the owner chooses to send, shown only after, say, 8 visits in a month; no automatic sending.

what: Add a ready "PT pack ending" WhatsApp message for members whose PT pack is almost used up
why: The panel already knows whose PT is ending (2 classes left or 7 days), but the ready messages cover only gym plans, so the trainer renews PT by remembering to ask
impact_why: PT is the gym's highest-earning add-on; a missed renewal is money lost
my_view: My view: do it; reuse the plan-ending words with the classes-left count.

what: Next to "No new best in 6 weeks, a good time to offer personal training", add a one-tap WhatsApp offer and a count of such members on the trainer's list
why: The line tells staff who to approach but stops there; the trainer must find the number and write the offer
impact_why: Turns an existing hint into a PT sale in one tap
my_view: My view: do it, with the offer wording soft and editable; never shown to the member automatically.

what: In the owner's free-trial banner, show what the gym built during the trial (members added, fees recorded, check-ins)
why: The banner only counts days left and asks for a pack; showing the work already in the app makes paying feel like keeping it, the usual trial-to-paid approach in SaaS (HubSpot, Zoho, as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live)
impact_why: Trial-to-paid is MettleUp's own revenue; this is the banner every trial owner sees daily
my_view: My view: do it in the last 14 days of the trial only, three numbers at most.

what: Give the Monday WhatsApp summary a comparison with the week before on each number (for example: Money collected Rs 42,000, up Rs 5,000)
why: The summary lists last week's numbers alone, so the owner cannot tell good from bad; Today already words changes this way
impact_why: The owner reads it every Monday and forwards it to partners
my_view: My view: do it; the comparison words already exist on Today, so reuse them.

what: Add a ready "please rate us on Google" WhatsApp message, offered on the joining anniversary or after a member's tenth visit
why: Local gyms in India are found on Google Maps, and reviews come from happy regulars, yet none of the ready messages asks for one
impact_why: More reviews bring more walk-in enquiries at no cost
my_view: My view: do it, with the gym's own review link typed once in Settings; offered, never sent by itself.
